references.text: Abidan, son of Gideoni, is first mentioned as the leader of the tribe of Benjamin at the census.
Abidan, son of Gideoni, brought his offering as the leader of the tribe of Benjamin at the dedication of the tabernacle.
Abidan, son of Gideoni, led the army of the tribe of Benjamin when the Israelites broke camp from Sinai.
Benjamin was Jacob's youngest son, born to Rachel, and became the ancestor of the tribe of Benjamin.
The sons of Benjamin who went to Egypt with Jacob show the origin of the tribe.
